result.reason: The redline does not reach the playbook position. Although Affiliates and contractors are added to the grant, unchanged clauses (c) and (e) still prohibit sublicensing, transfer, disclosure, or access to anyone other than Licensee employees, creating a direct conflict. It also omits transferability to successors and does not provide that any paid-up licence is perpetual and irrevocable. The uncured-material-breach standard is added, but the remaining reference to “immediate termination” is inconsistent. The changes are otherwise limited and preserve the Field of Use and other unrelated commercial terms.
